trial_court: Family Court at Hyderabad, F.C.O.P.No.377 of 2013
case_name: Mr. Nirmalia Bhattacharya vs Ms. Sonali Mukherjee
facts_of_case: The respondent filed an application under Section 13(1)(ia) of Hindu Marriage Act,1955 seeking dissolution of marriage and permanent alimony. The appellant is the husband who failed to consummate the marriage. The trial court decided in favor of the respondent.

legal_principles.principle: A spouse's failure to consummate a marriage without reasonable cause can be considered as cruelty.
legal_principles.held: The appellant, without any reasonable cause failed to consummate the marriage though the respondent was ready and later also, he badly failed to consummate the marriage.

legal_principles.principle: A party's failure to attend a court hearing without reasonable cause can be considered as abandonment of the case.
legal_principles.held: Despite receipt of notice, appellant herein failed to attend the Family Court and he was set ex parte.

outcome.final_order: The appeal was allowed, and the order dated 29.11.2013 passed by the learned Judge, Family Court at Hyderabad, was set aside.

use_for_drafting: representing clients in family court appeals
